18.b37.box: From Paradise to the constellations, the Trinity personalities uphold the universe with perfect justice and counsel, and they honor even the lowliest personality.
19.title: The Co-ordinate Trinity-Origin Beings
19.b0.ask: “How do the wisdom, counsel, and judgment of the Trinity become living persons who serve the universe?”
19.b2.p: In Paper 18 we saw the seven orders of Supreme Trinity Personalities, who govern from Paradise down to the constellations. Now Paper 19 turns to other beings who also come from the Trinity: the Co-ordinate Trinity-origin Beings. The author of this paper, a Divine Counselor, is himself one of them.
19.b3.p: This group includes the Trinity Teacher Sons, three groups of high superuniverse administrators, the mysterious Inspired Trinity Spirits, and the Havona natives and Paradise Citizens. Except for the Teacher Sons and possibly the Inspired Spirits, their numbers are fixed; their creation is a finished and past event.
19.b4.p: What are these beings, and how do the wisdom, counsel, and judgment of the Trinity become living persons who reach all the way to us, the evolving creatures of time?
19.b5.q: ⟦Q 19:4.4⟧In this juridical trio the Perfector of Wisdom would be the “I was,” the Divine Counselor the “I will be,” but the Universal Censor is always “I am.”⟦/Q⟧
19.b9.p: The Trinity Teacher Sons act in a dual capacity: they are of Trinity origin, but in function they are almost wholly devoted to the services of divine sonship. They are the liaison beings who bridge the gulf between Trinity-origin and dual-origin personalities, and they are the supreme co-ordinating personalities of Trinity origin.
19.b10.p: Here the author pauses to explain why this revelation begins not with man but with Paradise. A method that moves only from the lower to the higher can show us where man came from, but it reveals little or nothing about his divine destiny. A true perspective comes only from studying origin, history, and destiny together.
19.b11.t: Errors of reasoning only from below
It may utterly fail to perceive the final evolutionary goal
It distorts facts and misreads destinies
How a being became does not show its present true character
History alone does not reveal the future
19.b12.q: ⟦Q 19:1.11⟧Finite origins are helpful, but only divine causes reveal final effects.⟦/Q⟧
19.b14.p: The Perfectors of Wisdom personify the wisdom of divinity in the superuniverses. There are exactly seven billion of them, one billion in each superuniverse. They do not reflect the wisdom of the Paradise Trinity; they are that wisdom.
19.b15.p: Wisdom has two sources: the divine insight of perfect beings and the personal experience gained by evolutionary creatures. Neither alone exhausts the potentials of all possible wisdom. That is why the Perfectors of Wisdom always work together with administrators who have risen from the ranks of ascending mortals.
19.b16.t: The personal experience of evolutionary creatures
Mighty Messengers, Those without Name and Number, Those High in Authority
19.b18.p: The Divine Counselors are the counsel of Deity itself to the seven superuniverses. Twenty-one billion of them serve, three billion in each superuniverse. One Perfector of Wisdom, seven Divine Counselors, and one Universal Censor together form a tribunal of Trinity divinity, the highest mobile advisory body in time and space. In all the annals of the superuniverses, such a verdict has never been reversed by the Ancients of Days.
19.b19.p: When this divine counsel is joined by the experiential counsel of perfected beings of evolutionary ascent, the combined conclusions are not only complete but replete. Only the Paradise bestowal Sons, who are both God and man, come closer to uniting the attitudes of the creature and the Creator.
19.b21.p: There are exactly eight billion Universal Censors, and they are the judgment of the Trinity itself. Even the Ancients of Days do not sit in judgment without them. When all the testimony, wisdom, and counsel have been gathered, the Censor gives the true and unerring total of it all — and when he speaks, there is no appeal.
19.b23.p: The author admits that the Censors seem to formulate new meanings and values from the facts set before them, and that their verdicts cannot be predicted; it seems they are in some way in liaison with the Deity Absolute. The Perfectors of Wisdom, Divine Counselors, and Universal Censors, together with the seven orders of Supreme Trinity Personalities, make up the ten groups of Stationary Sons of the Trinity, numbering slightly more than thirty-seven billion.
19.b25.p: The Inspired Trinity Spirits are one of the few wholly secret orders of beings. They may be superpersonal spirits, and even Trinity-origin beings can recognize them only under certain conditions. Only the Solitary Messengers sense their presence, as unfailingly as a magnetic needle points to a pole. Even as the author was writing, such a Spirit was with him, not over twenty-five feet away.
19.b26.p: On a planet whose people are indwelt by Thought Adjusters, a Solitary Messenger feels a similar qualitative stirring, which suggests that the Adjusters and the Inspired Spirits are connected in some way. The Teacher Sons devote themselves to conscious enlightenment; the Inspired Spirits may be teachers who work by superconscious techniques. For there is spiritual truth that self-consciousness would keep us from receiving.
19.b27.q: ⟦Q 19:5.12⟧You will long use faith and be dependent on revelation if you hope to progress quickly and safely.⟦/Q⟧
19.b29.p: The Havona natives are the direct creation of the Paradise Trinity, and only when we reach Havona will we be able to greet them as spirit comrades. Ascending mortals and Havoners do each other great good. Through friendship with them we make up for the spiritual poverty of our early stages, and through contact with us they overcome the experiential handicap of having always lived a life of divine perfection.
19.b30.p: Unlike the Stationary Sons, the Havona natives may evolve in status, and some of them enter the finaliter corps. Since no more are being created, their number is slowly diminishing, and it is thought that the Havona of the future may be peopled by a mixed group of residents.
19.b31.t: Now the permanent citizens of the local universe constellations
Born in the flowering of the ages of light and life
Beings arriving from the outer universes
19.b32.q: ⟦Q 19:6.8⟧The universe is nonstatic; only God is changeless.⟦/Q⟧
19.b34.p: More than three thousand orders of Paradise Citizens dwell on Paradise. Because they are not directly concerned with the ascension plan, they are not fully revealed to us; together with the Havona natives they are called Paradise-Havona personalities. Of all the beings the Trinity has brought into existence, none have ever gone astray, and yet in the highest sense they are all freewill endowed. They travel freely without the help of seraphim; the author tells us his journey from Uversa to Urantia took 109 days.
19.b36.p: Paper 19 shows how the character of the Trinity becomes living persons. The Perfector of Wisdom is wisdom itself, the Divine Counselor is counsel itself, and the Universal Censor is judgment itself. Yet even these perfect beings do not work alone; they always judge together with ascending mortals who gained their wisdom by experience. The Havona natives, too, rise above the limits of their experience through friendship with us. In a universe where perfection and experience complete each other, the author invites us to see man from Paradise outward. A true perspective opens when we look not only at our origin but at our destiny, and along the way we will long use faith and depend on revelation.
19.b37.t: A true perspective comes from seeing destiny as well as origin
The wisdom of divine insight and the wisdom of experience work together
The verdict of the tribunal of nine is as if the Ancients of Days had spoken
The Censor gives the true total of all testimony, and there is no appeal
Unseen Spirits may be teaching us superconsciously
Ascenders and Havoners enrich each other through friendship
None of the beings the Trinity has brought forth have ever gone astray
19.b39.box: The wisdom, counsel, and judgment of the Trinity have become living persons who serve the universe together with ascenders perfected through experience.
20.title: The Paradise Sons of God
20.b0.ask: “Why do the Sons of Paradise come down to the evolutionary worlds in the very form of mortals like us?”
20.b2.p: In Paper 19 we met the beings who come from the Paradise Trinity, including the Stationary Sons who govern the superuniverses. Now Paper 20 turns to the name “Son” itself. As they function in Orvonton, the Sons of God fall into three general groups.
20.b3.p: Descending Sons are personalities of direct and divine creation. Ascending sons, such as mortals, achieve this status by taking part in evolution through experience. Trinitized Sons are a group of composite origin, embraced by the Trinity. This paper looks closely at the Sons who descend from Paradise, especially the Magisterial Sons and the Trinity Teacher Sons.
20.b4.p: What, then, do these high Sons do, and why do they choose to be born of woman, to live, and to die as we do?
20.b5.q: ⟦Q 20:1.11⟧From the standpoint of service, worship, and supplication the Paradise Sons are as one; their spirit is one, and their work is identical in quality and completeness.⟦/Q⟧
20.b8.t: Personalities of direct and divine creation
A group of composite origin embraced by the Trinity
20.b9.p: All descending Sons have high and divine origins, and they are dedicated to helping the lowly creatures of evolutionary origin in their climb to Paradise. Seven orders of them are described: the first three are Paradise Sons, and the other four are Local Universe Sons of God.
20.b10.t: The Michaels — the Universal Father and the Eternal Son
The Avonals — the Eternal Son and the Infinite Spirit
The Daynals — the Father, Son, and Spirit
A Creator Son, Creative Spirit, and Father Melchizedek
A Creator Son and Creative Spirit — the Most Highs, Constellation Fathers
A Creator Son and Creative Spirit — System Sovereigns and Planetary Princes
A Creator Son, Creative Spirit, and one of the Ancients of Days
20.b11.p: The Paradise Sons have shown themselves as creators, servers, bestowers, judges, teachers, and truth revealers. In a local universe the Magisterial and Teacher Sons serve under the direction of the Creator Son of that domain. The Creator Son has a spiritual drawing power that duplicates, within his local universe, the drawing power of the Eternal Son, and he is personally conscious of every act and emotion of every descending Son serving in his realm. The Michael order is saved for the next paper; this one deals with the Magisterial and Teacher Sons.
20.b13.p: Every time an original concept of being formed by the Eternal Son unites with a new ideal of loving service conceived by the Infinite Spirit, a new Magisterial Son, an Avonal, comes into being. They are not creators in the personal sense, but they are closely associated with the Michaels in all their work; they are planetary ministers and judges. There are about one billion of them in the grand universe. They are directed by their supreme council on Paradise, but once assigned to a local universe they serve under its Creator Son.
20.b14.t: Ending dispensations and liberating sleeping survivors — scores, even hundreds of times
Appearing as an adult before the bestowal Son — possibly many times
Being born of woman — only once on each planet
20.b15.p: Usually, after an Avonal has passed seven times through magisterial and bestowal experience, he gives way to others with less such service and joins the high personal council of a Creator Son. On the inhabited worlds the Avonals are helped by the Melchizedeks and the archangels, and on bestowal missions they are accompanied by the Brilliant Evening Stars. Because the full power and authority of the Creator Son stands behind them, their work is just as effective as the service of a Creator Son himself would have been.
20.b17.p: The Avonals are the judges of the successive dispensations of the worlds of time. They preside over the awakening of the sleeping survivors, bring to an end a dispensation of suspended justice, and assign the space creatures to the tasks of the new age. They may render judgments extinguishing the identity of personal creatures, but such sentences are executed by none but the authorities of a superuniverse.
20.b18.t: Not incarnated; comes as an invisible spiritual being
Sometimes incarnated — appearing as an adult
20.b19.p: On any incarnated mission, the Son judges the passing planetary age. When a Paradise Son visits an evolutionary world and becomes like one of its people, his very presence ends a dispensation and is a judgment of the realm.
20.b21.p: On an initial magisterial visit, the Avonal is always incarnated as a full-grown male of the mortal races, fully visible to the people of his day and in physical contact with them. Throughout, his connection with the spiritual forces remains unbroken. An incarnated Paradise Son is indwelt by an experienced Adjuster. Such Adjusters can never gain personality through fusion, but they are often personalized by the Father’s fiat and form the supreme Divinington council of direction.
20.b22.p: Urantia has never been host to an Avonal Son on a magisterial mission. Under the usual plan one would have come between the days of Adam and Michael’s bestowal, but the terminal bestowal of our Creator Son wholly upset that order. And since Michael has promised to return, only time can reveal the future order of visitations by the Paradise Sons.
20.b23.h: 5. Bestowal of the Paradise Sons of God
20.b24.p: The Eternal Son is the eternal Word of God. When a divine extension of this Son begins a mortal incarnation, it becomes literally true that the “⟦Q 20:5.1⟧Word is made flesh.⟦/Q⟧” But the purpose of a bestowal is not to change the attitude of the Universal Father. Bestowal is a necessary part of the experience that makes these Sons safe and sympathetic magistrates and rulers of the peoples of time and space.
20.b25.q: ⟦Q 20:5.4⟧It is only required that each inhabited world have one bestowal Son come to live the full mortal life from birth to death.⟦/Q⟧
20.b26.p: A bestowal also has a very practical result. Only after the bestowal Son returns to universe headquarters and the Spirit of Truth is poured out do Thought Adjusters come to all normal human beings. Urantia draws so much attention because this small planet was the scene of Michael’s final bestowal. Yet no planet could ever be in such a condition that it would require the bestowal of a Creator Son; the Magisterial Sons are just as divinely effective, and no record exists of either kind of Son failing on a bestowal mission.
20.b28.p: How a Paradise Son comes to be born of a mother is a universal mystery, and we are told to waste no time on futile conjectures about the technique. A bestowal Son is always born of woman, grows from infancy through youth to manhood, works at ordinary callings, and makes petitions to the Father. There is only one exception: he does not beget offspring.
20.b29.t: “⟦Q 20:6.5⟧Whosoever has seen the Son has seen the Father⟦/Q⟧”
“⟦Q 20:6.5⟧Whosoever has seen me has seen the Eternal Son of God⟦/Q⟧”
The will of the Eternal Son
20.b30.p: A bestowal Son must pass through death, but that death need not be violent. Urantia has become known as “⟦Q 20:6.6|57:8.6|119:8.8⟧the world of the cross⟦/Q⟧” because of the unusually cruel experience of Jesus. The Sons do not die to satisfy “divine wrath” but give up their lives freely “⟦Q 20:6.7|139:3.8|171:0.5⟧to drink the cup⟦/Q⟧” of the creature’s life. When the bestowal is finished, the Avonal and the Creator Son together send the Spirit of Truth; and after Michael’s final bestowal, that spirit becomes more literally the spirit of the sovereign Michael.
20.b32.p: The Daynals are highly personal and highly spiritual Sons brought into being by the Paradise Trinity. Their number keeps growing; a little more than twenty-one billion serve in the central and superuniverses. They are neither creators nor retrievers, neither judges nor rulers. They are concerned not so much with administration as with moral enlightenment and spiritual development; they are the universal educators.
20.b34.p: They receive no preliminary training in the central universe but are sent directly to the superuniverse headquarters. And since they do not possess a spiritual drawing power of their own, they work through the combined spiritual influence of a Creator Son and the Magisterial Sons.
20.b35.h: 8. Local Universe Ministry of the Daynals
20.b36.p: The Daynals are the only Trinity creatures so completely associated with the conduct of the dual-origin universes. They begin in the local systems and advance through the constellations to the highest work of the local creation. The staff of the University of Salvington alone numbers over one hundred thousand, and the Teacher Sons care just as much for the instruction of seraphim and other natives of the local creation as for mortals.
20.b37.p: The Teacher Sons form the faculties that give all the examinations and tests for every lower phase of universe service. They are the exalted teachers of all spirit personalities — even the teachers of the Sons of God themselves.
20.b39.p: When an evolutionary world is ripe for a spiritual age, the Teacher Sons volunteer. Urantia has never experienced such an age, but the Teacher Sons even now visit our world to make plans. They will appear after we have gained comparative deliverance from the shackles of animalism and from the fetters of materialism.
20.b40.t: Has nothing to do with it
Judgment and the opening of a new age
The opening of a spiritual age
20.b41.p: A Teacher Son usually stays one thousand years, presiding over the planetary millennium with seventy associates, and he keeps contact with mortals through the Brilliant Evening Stars. After their final mission the planet is settled in light and life. On Uversa it is believed that these Sons will one day be transferred to eternal association with the Corps of the Finality.
20.b42.h: 10. United Ministry of the Paradise Sons
20.b43.p: All the Paradise Sons are divine in origin and nature, and the work of each for each world is just as if he were the first and only Son of God. The three orders of Sons work together to reveal the three Deities to the creatures of space.
20.b44.t: The infinite character of the Universal Father — love
The compassion of the Eternal Son — mercy
The teacher personality of the Infinite Spirit — ministry
20.b45.q: ⟦Q 20:10.2⟧The Creator, Magisterial, and Teacher Sons are the gifts of the eternal Deities to the children of men and to all other universe creatures of ascension potential.⟦/Q⟧
20.b47.p: Paper 20 shows that the Sons of God are not distant officials in the sky. The Avonals judge the worlds age after age; sometimes they are born of woman and live and die as we do, and through their bestowal they open the way for the Spirit of Truth and the Thought Adjusters to come to everyone. Bestowal is not meant to change the Father’s heart; it is the path by which the Sons become rulers who understand us through experience. After them come the Daynals, who open a spiritual age that lasts a thousand years and lead the planet toward light and life. Michaels, Avonals, and Daynals work as one, revealing the three Deities to us through love, mercy, and ministry.
20.b48.t: Section
Key message
The Descending Sons of God
Seven orders of descending Sons help the ascenders
The Magisterial Sons
Avonals serve the planets in three roles: judgment, magisterial missions, and bestowal
Judicial Actions
The very presence of a Paradise Son judges an age
Magisterial Missions
Urantia has never yet been visited by a Magisterial Son
Bestowal of the Paradise Sons of God
Bestowal does not appease the Father; it is the Son’s path of experience
The Mortal-Bestowal Careers
A bestowal Son is born, lives, and dies, but a violent death is not required
The Trinity Teacher Sons
The Daynals are educators devoted to spiritual awakening, not to rule
Local Universe Ministry of the Daynals
The Teacher Sons are teachers even of the Sons of God
Planetary Service of the Daynals
A Teacher Son stays a thousand years and opens a spiritual age
United Ministry of the Paradise Sons
The three orders of Sons together reveal the three Deities
20.b50.box: The Paradise Sons are the gifts of the eternal Deities, coming down among us to reveal the three Deities through love, mercy, and teaching.
21.title: The Paradise Creator Sons
21.b0.ask: “Why does a Creator Son earn again, through seven bestowals, the sovereignty he already holds?”
21.b2.p: Paper 20 looked at the Magisterial and Teacher Sons among the Paradise Sons and saved the Michael order for later. Paper 21 tells the story of those Creator Sons. They are the makers and rulers of the local universes of time and space, and they embody the characteristics of both God the Father and God the Son.
21.b3.p: Each Creator Son is unique in nature as well as in personality, the “only-begotten Son” of his origin. As he goes forth to found his universe he is called a Creator Michael, and when settled in supreme authority, a Master Michael. The original Michael passed seven times through the circuits of Havona, and there is no essential experience of the children of time and space in which the Michaels have not personally taken part.
21.b4.p: Why, then, do these Sons, who hold all the power of creation, humble themselves to live seven times in the likeness of their own creatures?
21.b5.q: ⟦Q 21:6.4⟧Just as the Deity of the Supreme is actualizing by virtue of experiential service, so are the Creator Sons achieving the personal realization of the Paradise-divinity potentials bound up in their unfathomable natures.⟦/Q⟧
21.b7.h: 1. Origin and Nature of Creator Sons
21.b8.p: When the absolute spiritual ideation of the Eternal Son fully unites with the absolute personality concept of the Universal Father, a new Creator Son flashes into full-fledged being, without the loss of anything by either Deity. Each such Son is the final expression of every possibility of that union, so there never can be another such Son. Each is the absolute of the united deity concepts which constitute his divine origin.
21.b9.p: A Creator Son’s nature comes equally from both parents, but in practice some resemble the Father more and others the Son. The trend of administration in Nebadon suggests that our Creator Son more resembles the Eternal Mother Son. There are believed to be more than seven hundred thousand Creator Sons, already exceeding the fixed number of seven hundred thousand Unions of Days.
21.b11.p: A Creator Son is the designer, builder, and administrator of a local universe, the basic creative unit of the seven evolutionary superuniverses. He chooses his own site in space, but only after Paradise observation, Havona training, and a long study of the creations of his older brothers. When he leaves Paradise, he is accompanied by a Creative Daughter of the Infinite Spirit, who will become the Mother Spirit of the new local universe.
21.b12.t: The Infinite Spirit — new forms require his consent and co-operation
The Eternal Son — new types require his consent
Designed and bestowed by the Universal Father
The endowment of the Third Source and Center
In the last analysis, controlled by the Trinity
21.b13.p: Since no two Creator Sons are exactly alike, the creatures of their local universes differ as well. Within a superuniverse, half of their inherent attributes are alike, coming from the uniform Creative Spirits, and half vary, coming from the diverse Creator Sons. When a Michael is away, the Bright and Morning Star directs the government, while the Mother Spirit always remains at headquarters, extending her ministry to the farthest parts of the realm. An established universe runs smoothly even without his personal presence.
21.b15.p: A Creator Son receives title to his universe by the consent of the Trinity, but his experiential supremacy comes from his own experience in creation and in incarnated bestowal. Until then he rules as vicegerent of the Universal Father. He could assert full sovereignty at any time, but he wisely chooses not to — and no Michael ever has.
21.b16.q: ⟦Q 21:3.14⟧Virtue is volitional with personality; righteousness is not automatic in freewill creatures.⟦/Q⟧
21.b17.t: Solitary provisional authority before the Creative Spirit becomes personal
Joint rule of the Paradise pair after the Mother Spirit attains personality
Growing authority during the seven creature bestowals
Settled authority after the seventh bestowal — in Nebadon, since the Urantia bestowal
After most of the realms are settled in light and life
After the whole local universe is settled in light and life
The unknown relationships of a future universe age
21.b18.p: In a universe without rebellion the limits of prebestowal sovereignty simply do not show; in a universe with rebellion they do. Gaining supreme sovereignty means passing through seven creature levels by incarnation, consecrating himself on each to one phase of the sevenfold will of Deity personified in the Seven Master Spirits, and unifying the two. In this way a Creator Son not only proves his own fitness to rule but also reveals the nature of the Deities.
21.b20.p: Avonal bestowals are always in the likeness of mortal flesh, but the seven bestowals of a Creator Son span seven creature levels of being. They always include a mortal bestowal, and in the final one he appears among one of the higher mortal races, usually the group with the largest legacy of Adamic stock. Only once in his sevenfold career is he born of woman, and only once does he live and die as a member of the lowest order of will creatures.
21.b21.p: After each bestowal he goes to the “⟦Q 21:4.4|5:2.2|13:2.7⟧right hand of the Father⟦/Q⟧” to gain the Father’s acceptance. The Son who came to Urantia had already completed six phases of his bestowal career, so when he said on the cross, “⟦Q 21:4.5|181:2.20|187:5.5⟧It is finished,⟦/Q⟧” it was literally finished. From then on he rules not as the Father’s vicegerent but in his own right and name as “⟦Q 21:4.5⟧King of Kings and Lord of Lords.⟦/Q⟧” A Creator Son who completes his bestowals becomes a Master Son, one who has added the experience of a creature to his own nature.
21.b22.q: ⟦Q 21:4.6⟧Why should man bemoan his lowly origin and enforced evolutionary career when the very Gods must pass through an equivalent experience before they are accounted experientially worthy and competent finally and fully to rule over their universe domains!⟦/Q⟧
21.b23.h: 5. Relation of Master Sons to the Universe
21.b24.p: The power of a Master Michael is unlimited because it comes from experienced association with the Paradise Trinity, and it is unquestioned because it comes from actually living as the very creatures under his authority.
21.b25.t: It embraces the sevenfold viewpoint of Paradise Deity
It embodies a sevenfold attitude of time-space creatures
It joins Paradise attitude and creature viewpoint into one
21.b26.p: With supreme sovereignty, a Michael gives up the power to create entirely new types of creatures in the present age and devotes himself to fostering the life already begun. From then on, what cannot be spiritualized will eventually be disorganized, and that which mercy cannot rehabilitate justice will eventually annihilate. Through the Spirit of Truth the Master Son keeps in touch with the worlds of his own sojourn and with all the worlds where an Avonal has bestowed himself, and his sympathy reaches from the Father on high to the lowliest races of time.
21.b28.p: No one can speak with final authority about the destiny of the Master Michaels, but each is believed to be the absolute of the dual deity concepts of his origin. In this age we see no action of theirs that is more than finite, and their being restricted from creating new types of beings is probably due to the liberation of superfinite potentials. In the far future, in the universes of outer space, the union of a Master Son and a Creative Spirit may reach absonite levels of service.
21.b29.p: Just as the Deity of the Supreme is actualized through experiential service, so the Creator Sons are realizing the divine potentials bound up in their natures. As Jesus said, “⟦Q 21:6.4|180:3.7|182:1.20⟧I am the way, the truth, and the life,⟦/Q⟧” so the Michaels are destined in eternity to light the path toward deity finality for all universe personalities.
21.b31.p: Paper 21 shows that a Creator Son is not a ruler who grips power and looks down from above. He is perfect enough to build a universe, yet instead of declaring his sovereignty he lives seven times in the likeness of his creatures and earns it through experience. His final bestowal took place on Urantia, and with the words “⟦Q 21:4.5|181:2.20|187:5.5⟧It is finished⟦/Q⟧” he became the Master Son of our universe. If even the Gods become fit to rule only by passing through experience, then our own evolutionary career, which begins from a lowly origin, is nothing to lament. It is an honor to walk the same road.
21.b32.t: Origin and Nature of Creator Sons
Each Michael is an only-begotten Son who can never be repeated
A Creator Son builds a unique universe together with the Mother Spirit
Sovereignty is earned through seven stages of experience, not declared
His death on Urantia finished his bestowal career
Relation of Master Sons to the Universe
Sovereignty earned by experience is unlimited and unquestioned
In eternity the Michaels become the way, the truth, and the life
21.b34.box: The Creator Son earned his sovereignty by living as his own creatures, and his path shows that our evolutionary career is also an honor.
22.title: The Trinitized Sons of God
22.b0.ask: “What does it mean for an evolving mortal to be embraced by the Trinity and become a Son who helps govern a superuniverse?”
22.b2.p: In Papers 20 and 21 we met the descending Sons who come down from Paradise. Paper 22 deals with the third group called Sons of God: the Trinitized Sons of God. What they share is the experience of trinitization, either as a part of their origin or through a later embrace by the Trinity.
22.b3.p: The Trinitized Sons are divided into Deity-trinitized Sons, Trinity-embraced Sons, and Creature-trinitized Sons. The Deity-trinitized Sons are not revealed, so this paper describes the other two groups, especially the Trinity-embraced sons. The author himself is a Mighty Messenger who was once a mortal.
22.b4.p: By what path, then, do mortals like us come to be embraced by the Trinity, and what do these Sons do in the superuniverses?
22.b5.q: ⟦Q 22:9.7⟧There is simply nothing in all universal existence which can take the place of actual personal experience⟦/Q⟧
22.b8.p: All Trinity-embraced sons are originally of dual or single origin, but after the Trinity embrace they are forever devoted to Trinity service. They form seven orders of personalities, which are further grouped into three divisions according to origin and nature.
22.b9.t: Mighty Messengers, Those High in Authority, Those without Name and Number
Adjuster-fused mortals who have attained the Corps of the Finality
Ascendant seraphim, translated midwayers, and Spirit- and Son-fused mortals
Creature-trinitized sons who have been twice trinitized
22.b10.p: When Sons of Attainment are embraced, their names are removed from the finaliter roll call; after brief training in Havona they are assigned to the service of the Ancients of Days. Their Trinity-origin associates are of fixed numbers, but the Trinity-embraced sons keep increasing, and not one has ever been lost. Only the Sons of Perfection have sometimes erred in judgment.
22.b12.p: The Mighty Messengers are perfected mortals who have been rebellion tested or otherwise equally proved in their loyalty. At some point in their ascent they stood firm and loyal in the face of the disloyalty of their superiors. Preventing a rebellion is regarded as of even greater value than loyalty in the face of an actual one. They are embraced in classes of seven hundred thousand, and almost one trillion are commissioned on Uversa.
22.b13.p: The author tells us that he is a Mighty Messenger, that the companion of his mortal life also triumphed in the great test, and that they were embraced in the same group and are now often sent out together from Uversa. In the superuniverse courts they act as defenders of individuals and planets, and they are stationed on many worlds as official observers of the Ancients of Days. Because they remember their whole ascendant careers, they will talk with us freely and understandingly as soon as we are delivered from the flesh.
22.b15.p: Those High in Authority are mortals who showed superior administrative ability and extraordinary executive genius throughout their long ascent. They are the cream of governing ability among surviving mortals. Seventy thousand are trinitized at a time, more than ten billion now serve in Orvonton, and Nebadon already has representatives in a recent class.
22.b16.p: In the superuniverse tribunals they present the cause of justice as prosecutors. So if we should ever be cited for errors of judgment during our ascent, we are hardly likely to suffer injustice, since our prosecutors would be onetime ascendant creatures who know every step of the career we are traveling.
22.b18.p: Those without Name and Number are ascendant souls who have developed the ability to worship beyond the skill of all the evolutionary races. More strictly translated, their name would be “⟦Q 22:4.1⟧Those above Name and Number.⟦/Q⟧” They are embraced in groups of seven thousand, and as the supreme jurors of Orvonton they judge questions that require a spiritual viewpoint and experience in the ascendant career.
22.b19.t: Loyalty in the face of rebellion
22.b20.p: Their selection is not arbitrary but inherent and automatic: personal experience and spiritual values determine who they are. They are not standardized beings; each has a distinct character. Whenever the viewpoint of a mortal creature is in doubt, an ascendant commission of one from each of these three orders settles the question.
22.b21.q: ⟦Q 22:4.7⟧You mortals who read this message may yourselves ascend to Paradise, attain the Trinity embrace⟦/Q⟧
22.b23.p: Trinity recognition is not open to mortals alone. Our faithful seraphic guardians and our midway associates may also be embraced when they reach Paradise. An ascendant seraphim receives this honor because of her valiant co-operation with a mortal who was later trinitized; the author’s own seraphic guardian now serves on Uversa as a Trinitized Custodian.
22.b24.p: The Custodians are embraced in groups of seventy thousand, one seventh of each group going to each superuniverse, and slightly over ten million serve in Orvonton. They do not deal with individuals but administer group affairs; they are the custodians of records, plans, and institutions, and the trustees of ascendant projects and morontia plans.
22.b26.p: Not all ascending mortals are Adjuster fused; some are Spirit fused and some Son fused. The Ambassadors are chosen from those of them who reach Paradise. They are trinitized in classes of seven thousand, and almost one-half billion are registered on Uversa. Chosen on the advice of their Havona teachers, they are the superior minds of their groups and understand well the interests of the worlds from which the Spirit-fused mortals come.
22.b27.p: The Ambassadors are the emissaries of the Ancients of Days to any world or universe within their superuniverse, the emergency or reserve corps of the supergovernments. They carry out thousands of tasks that cannot be described to us, since nothing on Urantia is in any way like them.
22.b29.p: The techniques of trinitization are among the secrets of Vicegerington and Solitarington and cannot be fully unfolded to the material mind. Aside from the Deities, only Paradise-Havona personalities and certain finaliters engage in it, and a glorified creature may take part only once. If two finaliters show that they have independently chosen the same concept, they may be granted an extended recess to attempt it, and Master Spirit Number Seven authorizes the undertaking.
22.b30.p: Such an adventure may take an age, and it may fail through no fault of the pair. Those who fail join a special group of finaliters who have made the supreme effort and sustained the supreme disappointment. When they succeed, the two parents become one on the ultimate functional level: where one goes the other goes.
22.b31.t: Concepts of the Almighty Supreme acquired in the ascent
High spiritual aspects of the Supreme Being
A finaliter together with a Paradise-Havoner
Actualities of Supreme-Ultimate Deity — wards of the Architects
22.b33.p: All creature-trinitized beings, revealed or unrevealed, receive personality from the Universal Father. When young, they serve on the Paradise spheres of the Infinite Spirit under the Supreme Executives; later they may be adopted by the Trinity Teacher Sons and trained as apprentices in the local universes.
22.b34.p: The Teacher Sons may nominate these wards for the Trinity embrace, and those embraced become Trinitized Sons of Perfection. Others become associates of the Master Spirits or of the Mother Spirits, and the supreme destiny of most seems to be entrance into the Corps of Trinitized Finaliters.
22.b36.p: Creature-trinitized sons are embraced in classes of seven thousand. Those of more acceptable service become High Son Assistants; those of less distinguished performance become Celestial Guardians. The Celestial Guardians are officers of the courts of the Ancients of Days, bearing summonses and decisions and serving as the apprehending agents who carry out orders of detention.
22.b37.p: They have never been fused with an Adjuster, a Spirit, or a Son, and they lack the deep personal experience of having climbed up to glory from the dark domains of space. The author has often seen them look longingly at newly arrived mortals on the mansion worlds. They make us ever grateful for our lowly origin and our capacity for experience.
22.b39.p: The High Son Assistants serve as private secretaries to the high sons of the governments of the Ancients of Days. Their great strength is that each embodies a single supreme concept that had never before been trinitized. They are that idea personified.
22.b40.p: When the author headed a commission, nothing helped so much as the presence of an Assistant who embodied the very idea the problem concerned. But each superuniverse receives only one seventh of these beings, so Uversa encourages both pilgrims and Paradise residents to attempt trinitization. They are affectionate and loyal, and outside their own idea they humbly seek knowledge even from ascending mortals.
22.b42.p: Paper 22 shows that the superuniverse governments are not run by beings from Paradise alone. Mortals who stayed loyal in the face of rebellion, mortals who excelled in administration, and mortals who worshiped deeply are embraced by the Trinity, and they defend, judge, and govern. Our seraphic guardians and midway companions may walk the same road. Meanwhile the twice-trinitized sons, wonderful as they are, envy the experience of the ascenders. This contrast reminds us that our own experience, rising from a lowly origin, has a value that nothing in the universe can replace.
22.b43.t: Not one of the seven orders of embraced sons has ever been lost
Mortals who stayed loyal in the face of rebellion become messengers of the superuniverse
Our prosecutors have walked our path, so injustice is unlikely
Souls gifted in worship become the supreme jurors of Orvonton
Seraphim and midwayers can also receive Trinity recognition
Spirit-fused and Son-fused mortals become emissaries of the superuniverse
Two finaliters bring a single concept into actual being
They train as apprentices of the Teacher Sons for superuniverse service
Sons without experience envy the ascenders’ experience
Each embodies one idea in person and so aids superuniverse administration
22.b45.box: The Trinity embrace is open to mortals who rise through experience, and actual personal experience can be replaced by nothing in the universe.
23.title: The Solitary Messengers
23.b0.ask: “How do spirit messengers who love to work alone bind together the personalities of the whole universe?”
23.b2.p: In Paper 22 we saw the Trinity-embraced sons serving the superuniverses. Now Paper 23 turns to the family of the Infinite Spirit and introduces the first and senior order of its Higher Personalities: the Solitary Messengers. They represent the first creative act of the Infinite Spirit working alone, without the direct participation of the Father or the Son.
23.b3.p: The Solitary Messengers were personalized in a single creative episode, and their number is fixed. Almost 7,690 trillion of them are at work in Orvonton alone, which is thought to be considerably less than one seventh of the total. The Divine Counselor who presents this paper is accompanied by one of them on this very mission.
23.b4.p: Who, then, are these messengers who cross the universe alone and without form, and why would universe administration lose most of its personal element without them?
23.b5.q: ⟦Q 23:2.12⟧The Creators are possessed of full power to make Urantia a veritable paradise, but such an Eden would not contribute to the development of those strong, noble, and experienced characters⟦/Q⟧
23.b7.h: 1. Nature and Origin of Solitary Messengers
23.b8.p: Immediately after creating the Seven Spirits of the Havona Circuits, the Infinite Spirit brought the Solitary Messengers into being. Nothing in creation is older than they, except Paradise and the Havona circuits. They are aware of a beginning of selfhood, and they were the first creation of the Infinite Spirit to possess time consciousness. They are all equal; their classifications are based wholly on the work they are assigned.
23.b9.p: Mortals start out on the worlds of space and ascend toward the center; these spirits start out at the center and crave assignment to the most remote worlds. Though called Solitary Messengers, they are not lonesome spirits, for they truly like to work alone. Since they can “listen in” on all the broadcasts, they are never isolated. No Solitary Messenger has ever stumbled into darkness. They could be cited before no one except the Seven Master Spirits, and that has never happened.
23.b10.p: There is also a technical reason they must travel alone. If two or more are close together while in transit, they are “short circuited” and cut off from their Paradise circuit, so they carry an automatic alarm that warns them of approaching conflicts. They have no power to reproduce or extend their personalities, but they help everyone, from the highest to the lowest, and are the great timesavers of universe administration.
23.b12.p: The Solitary Messengers are not permanently attached to any individual or group, and among themselves they have neither organization nor government. The Infinite Spirit assigns them to seven divisions of service, but they move freely from one to another. To the Infinite Spirit each is known by a personal name.
23.b13.t: Trusted and secret servants of the Deities — never known to betray a confidence
The first messengers ascenders will see face to face — in close communion with Havona natives
The only spirit intelligences sent directly from one superuniverse headquarters to another
Revealers of the Mother Spirit’s intent, under the jurisdiction of the Master Son
Finding and charting new energy centers in outer space
6. Ambassadors and Emissaries of Special Assignment
Acting ambassadors between distant local universes
The highest trust of their order — attached to revelatory commissions
23.b14.p: The fact that the Trinity messengers never betray a secret shows that the Deities can and do create perfect beings. Why, then, does the confusion of Urantia remain? It is not that the Paradise Rulers lack either interest or ability. It is part of a divine plan for forging strong and noble characters on this world.
23.b15.q: ⟦Q 23:2.12⟧Your anxieties and sorrows, your trials and disappointments, are just as much a part of the divine plan on your sphere⟦/Q⟧
23.b16.p: The messenger now working with the author was sent to the central universe for information long before there was life on Urantia, and he returned after almost a million years. Of all the superuniverses, the Solitary Messengers most delight to serve in Orvonton, because here the need is greatest and the opportunities for heroic effort are greatly multiplied.
23.b17.h: 3. Time and Space Services of Solitary Messengers
23.b18.p: The Solitary Messengers are the highest type of perfect and confidential personality for carrying urgent messages when broadcast or reflectivity will not serve. The universe has gravity traversers that move instantly, but most of them are not persons, and personal beings are handicapped by time and space. The Solitary Messengers are the only personal messengers who fill that gap.
23.b19.t: A Solitary Messenger (the author’s associate, on record)
Instantaneous — but most are not persons
23.b20.p: It is hard to explain to mortals how a being can be without form and yet have a real and definite personality. Usually, the freer a creature is from time and space, the fewer its personality prerogatives. The Solitary Messengers are the exception: they have nearly all the advantages of a formless spirit together with all the prerogatives of a full-fledged personality. No matter how much the universe may grow, no more of them will probably ever be created.
23.b22.p: The Solitary Messengers seem to be personality co-ordinators for all types of spirit beings. They help very different kinds of spirits understand and fraternize with one another, making all the personalities of the vast spiritual world akin and fostering a consciousness of group identity. Because their ability reaches even to the master universe overcontrollers, some think their creation is related to the Conjoint Actor’s bestowal of Supreme-Ultimate Mind.
23.b23.p: When a finaliter and a Paradise Citizen trinitize a “⟦Q 23:4.3⟧child of time and eternity⟦/Q⟧” and send it to Vicegerington, a Solitary Messenger is assigned as its guardian-companion and never leaves that world again. The messengers are of fixed numbers, but such trinitization seems unlimited, so one day the supply may run out — and the author does not know who will take up their work.
23.b24.t: Who will take up their work?
The personnel of the grand universe is undergoing reorganization
This is co-ordinated with the energy evolutions of outer space
They are under the exclusive direction of the Architects of the Master Universe
23.b25.p: The author believes that the eternal future will far transcend all that the eternal past has experienced, and that we, too, should look forward to those adventures with keen relish and ever-heightening expectation.
23.b27.p: The Solitary Messengers of Paper 23 work alone, yet they are never isolated. They cross the universe without form and at speeds far beyond light, yet they possess full personality, and because of them the vast administration of the universe does not lose its personal warmth. They keep secrets, reveal truth, and bind very different spirit beings together like one family. And in the middle of their story, this paper quietly reminds us that the sorrows and trials of Urantia are also part of a divine plan for forging strong and noble characters.
23.b28.t: Nature and Origin of Solitary Messengers
The first solitary creation of the Infinite Spirit, they love to work alone but are not lonely
They serve in seven divisions, and our own trials are part of the divine plan
Time and Space Services of Solitary Messengers
They combine the advantages of formless spirit with full personality
As personality co-ordinators, they make all spirit personalities akin
23.b30.box: The Solitary Messengers, the first messengers of the Infinite Spirit, cross the universe alone and join all spirit personalities into one family.
24.title: Higher Personalities of the Infinite Spirit
24.b0.ask: “How do the personalities of the Infinite Spirit, who tend the spirit circuits and keep count of every will out of our sight, lead us on our ascent all the way to Havona?”
24.b2.p: In Paper 23 we met the Solitary Messengers, the first of the Higher Personalities of the Infinite Spirit. Paper 24 introduces the other six orders. On Uversa all the personalities of the Conjoint Creator are divided into three grand divisions: the Higher Personalities of the Infinite Spirit, the Messenger Hosts of Space, and the Ministering Spirits of Time.
24.b3.p: The Higher Personalities work in seven divisions throughout the grand universe. Most of them have stations in the local universes, but they are not organically attached to the administrations of the evolutionary realms. Of the seven, only the Solitary Messengers and perhaps the Personal Aids range freely through the universe of universes.
24.b4.p: Where, then, does each of these personalities work, and which of them will one day welcome us in Havona?
24.b5.q: ⟦Q 24:6.9⟧You will sometime meet these noble beings face to face if you do not reject the certain and all-perfected plan designed to effect your survival and ascension.⟦/Q⟧
24.b8.t: No general headquarters; they roam the universe of universes
4. Personal Aids of the Infinite Spirit
The central Isle of Light, Paradise
The capitals of the local universes
The capitals of the local systems
24.b9.p: The power currents of space and the circuits of spirit energy may seem to run by themselves, but all of them are under intelligent supervision. The Universe Circuit Supervisors deal not with purely material energy but with the circuits of spiritual energy needed to sustain spirit beings and morontia creatures. They are the exclusive creation of the Infinite Spirit and are personalized in four orders.
24.b10.t: One on the pilot world of each of the seven Havona circuits — seven in all
Seven, on the worlds of the Supreme Executives — in charge of the superuniverse circuits
On the superuniverse headquarters — 84,691 on Uversa, still being created
One on each local universe headquarters — created in groups of seven hundred
24.b11.p: Circuit supervisors are not rotated; they serve forever where they were first assigned. Tertiary circuit supervisor number 572,842 has worked on Salvington since the early concept of our local universe. It is they who would isolate a world from the higher spirit circuits if its Planetary Prince rebelled, though they cannot annul the material currents of the power directors. We will recognize them as we ascend, but we will have no personal relations with them.
24.b13.p: Although the cosmic mind knows every thinking creature, there is also an independent method of keeping count of all will creatures. The Census Directors are in perfect synchrony with reflectivity and are personally responsive to intelligent will, so they become aware at once of the birth of will anywhere in the grand universe. They do not function on Paradise; there the Deities know all things.
24.b14.p: In Orvonton there are one hundred thousand of them under Usatia, the superuniverse chief. They do not record the details of our lives and deeds, only the fact of will function. The Census Director of Nebadon, number 81,412, is at this very moment personally aware of our living presence here on Urantia.
24.b15.q: ⟦Q 24:2.8⟧Census Directors register the existence of a new will creature when the first act of will is performed; they indicate the death of a will creature when the last act of will takes place.⟦/Q⟧
24.b16.h: 3. Personal Aids of the Infinite Spirit
24.b17.p: No one knows when or how the Personal Aids were created, and their number is estimated to extend high into the trillions. They exist for the exclusive assistance of the Infinite Spirit’s Paradise presence, and wherever the circuits of the Conjoint Creator reach, they may flash forth to carry out the Spirit’s bidding.
24.b18.p: They are all equal and identical, and they do not manifest a spirit presence to other spirit beings. This very lack of a presence-form makes them all the more useful to the Infinite Spirit. Of all the revealed beings who come from the Infinite Spirit, they are about the only ones we will not encounter on our ascent.
24.b20.p: The Seven Supreme Executives on the Paradise spheres of the Infinite Spirit are the administrative board for the seven superuniverses. The Associate Inspectors are the personal embodiment of their authority in the local universes. They are the joint offspring of the Infinite Spirit and the Seven Master Spirits, and seven hundred thousand were personalized. One is stationed on each local universe headquarters; he receives reports only from the Assigned Sentinels and reports only to the Supreme Executive of his superuniverse.
24.b22.p: The Assigned Sentinels are co-ordinating personalities and liaison representatives of the Supreme Executives, and there are exactly seven billion of them. One is stationed in each of the ten thousand systems of a local universe, and they are usually changed every millennium. They are among the highest ranking personalities on a system capital, yet they never take part in deliberations on system affairs; they are concerned almost exclusively with keeping the Associate Inspector informed on the welfare of their systems.
24.b23.t: The Supreme Executives’ line of co-ordination
All seven superuniverses — from the Paradise spheres of the Spirit
A whole local universe — at universe headquarters
A single local system — at the system capital
24.b24.p: This line of co-ordination is distinct from the administration of the Ancients of Days. Together with the omniaphim and many unrevealed personalities, it forms a centralized yet far-flung system of advice and co-ordination for the whole grand universe.
24.b26.p: The Graduate Guides lead the mortal graduates from the superuniverses of time through the Havona course of instruction and training, preparing them for Paradise and the Corps of the Finality. The guide who greets us on the outer Havona circuit will stay with us through our whole Havona career and will witness our entrance into the terminal slumber of time, the sleep that carries us to Paradise.
24.b27.p: When the first mortal pilgrim reached the outer circuit of Havona, he was greeted by Malvorian, the first of the Graduate Guides. That pilgrim, Grandfanda, came from superuniverse number one. His arrival sent the thrill of all time through the heavenly courts and marked the start of the first universe broadcast, the “⟦Q 24:6.8|26:9.4⟧space reports of glory.⟦/Q⟧”
24.b29.p: The Graduate Guides are believed to be transformed Havona Servitals of long experience. A servital returning from superuniverse service enjoys “personal contact” with the Paradise Central Shining and then disappears, and a little less than three days later a new Graduate Guide “spontaneously” appears on the outer circuit of Havona. Their number exactly equals the number of vanished servitals, and the two orders show an inexplicable attachment to each other.
24.b30.q: ⟦Q 24:7.5⟧And servital number 842,842,682,846,782 of Havona, named Sudna, came over from the superuniverse service, was received on Paradise, knew the Father, entered the divine embrace, and is not.⟦/Q⟧
24.b31.p: The Havona Servitals reflect, in the perfect central universe, certain evolutionary potentials of time and space, and it is thought that the Supreme Being, the experiential Deity, is in some way involved in their transformation. After Grandfanda’s arrival, sweeping changes took place in Havona, and the appearance of the Graduate Guides is God the Supreme’s response to the arrival of the first of his experiential children.
24.b33.p: Paper 24 shows that the universe is carefully tended even where we cannot see. The circuit supervisors guard the pathways of spirit energy, and the Census Director knows our existence personally from the first moment we exercise our will to the last. The Associate Inspectors and Assigned Sentinels carry news of the welfare of even the smallest system to Paradise. And when, at the end of our long ascent, we reach Havona, a Graduate Guide will greet us and lead us circuit by circuit to the threshold of Paradise. That meeting is a certain promise, as long as we do not reject the plan.
24.b34.t: The circuits of spirit energy flow under intelligent supervision
Our existence is registered from the moment we first exercise our will
Personal Aids of the Infinite Spirit
Without showing their presence, they serve the Infinite Spirit alone
They embody the authority of the Supreme Executives in the local universe
They faithfully report the welfare of every system
They greet us in Havona and lead us to the threshold of Paradise
Havona Servitals are transformed into guides through the divine embrace
24.b36.box: The Higher Personalities of the Infinite Spirit tend the universe unseen, and in Havona they will surely welcome everyone who does not reject the plan.
